label: f or 1 input at late original positions (t>=6) of long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at late positions (orig_idx 5-8, mostly 7-8, so mostly L=8-9 and the last 1-2 tokens before <DEL>), plus weakly at the <DEL> step (2.8% of mass). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<5. Within that window it is sparse and depends on the token: input f carries 49% of mass (12x lift) and digit 1 carries 13%; h, o, k, l add weaker contributions. The top activations are all f at the last original position, and they are stronger when the first token is d (8x lift) or a/i/u. The window alone (t>=6) gets 96% recall but 3% precision. Adding f/1 gives precision 0.21 and mass recall 0.60. Many f-at-late-position steps stay inactive, and many activations land on other tokens, so the token-and-context dependence is only partly captured.
